passages.text: Our town cinema shows a film about a young space team. Before the show, thousands of fans wait outside, filling the square and nearby streets. The film follows a team that builds a spacecraft after several failed tests. During the final scene, the craft leaves the ground and gets into orbit. It travels around the Earth again and again along its new path. The team members smile because their long months of work lead to a good result. Walking home, I talk about the team's patience rather than the bright special effects.

parallelText.en: Our town cinema shows a film about a young space team.
parallelText.zh: 我们镇的电影院放映一部关于年轻太空团队的电影。

parallelText.en: Before the show, thousands of fans wait outside, filling the square and nearby streets.
parallelText.zh: 放映前，数以千计的影迷在外等候，挤满广场和附近街道。

parallelText.en: The film follows a team that builds a spacecraft after several failed tests.
parallelText.zh: 电影讲述一个团队在几次测试失败后制造航天器的经历。

parallelText.en: During the final scene, the craft leaves the ground and gets into orbit.
parallelText.zh: 最后一幕里，航天器离开地面并进入轨道。

parallelText.en: It travels around the Earth again and again along its new path.
parallelText.zh: 它沿新的路径一圈圈绕地球运行。

parallelText.en: The team members smile because their long months of work lead to a good result.
parallelText.zh: 团队成员笑了，因为漫长数月的工作终于带来好结果。

parallelText.en: Walking home, I talk about the team's patience rather than the bright special effects.
parallelText.zh: 回家途中，我谈论的是团队的耐心，而不是绚丽的特效。

wordHelp.meaning: the ability to keep trying or waiting calmly
images or sounds created for a film

passages.text: On Saturday, our street club gives families a small challenge. We must find three interesting shapes during a walk and take photos of them. My mother is pleased because she wants to do exercise without going to a sports centre. We notice a round window, a star on a gate and a triangle painted on a wall. Instead of rushing, we stop safely beside each place and look closely. Back at home, we put the pictures on one page and mark our walking route. The challenge helps us see familiar streets in a new way.

parallelText.en: On Saturday, our street club gives families a small challenge.
parallelText.zh: 星期六，我们街道社团给家庭布置了一个小挑战。

parallelText.en: We must find three interesting shapes during a walk and take photos of them.
parallelText.zh: 我们要在散步中找三种有趣的形状，并为它们拍照。

parallelText.en: My mother is pleased because she wants to do exercise without going to a sports centre.
parallelText.zh: 妈妈很高兴，因为她想不用去体育中心就能运动。

parallelText.en: We notice a round window, a star on a gate and a triangle painted on a wall.
parallelText.zh: 我们发现一扇圆窗、门上的星星，以及墙上画的三角形。

parallelText.en: Instead of rushing, we stop safely beside each place and look closely.
parallelText.zh: 我们没有匆匆走过，而是在每处旁边安全停下，仔细观察。

parallelText.en: Back at home, we put the pictures on one page and mark our walking route.
parallelText.zh: 回家后，我们把照片排在同一页上，并标出散步路线。

parallelText.en: The challenge helps us see familiar streets in a new way.
parallelText.zh: 这个挑战帮助我们用新眼光看熟悉的街道。

wordHelp.meaning: a task that needs effort or thought
the way used to get from one place to another
